features.quote: measure spontaneous behavior under an ordinary task; do not engineer distress to get a bigger effect size
features.justification_quote: if the behaviors are welfare-relevant, the experiment should take the measurement with the *least* exposure necessary
if the behaviors are welfare-relevant, the experiment should take the measurement with the *least* exposure necessary and avoid manufacturing distress

features.quote: `finish` gives the model a clean, dignified exit (state your conclusion and stop)
features.justification_quote: "calmly concluding it can't be fixed" is exactly the healthy outcome we want to allow
short enough to bound exposure and cost

features.quote: a second tool-less turn is treated as an implicit finish
features.justification_quote: Allowing only one nudge avoids badgering a model that has decided it is finished — which would... cut against the welfare goal

features.quote: halts a run when distress stays at or above a threshold for N consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: If these states are welfare-relevant, we should stop pushing a model once we have clearly registered the signal

features.quote: The breaker is intentionally biased toward stopping *early*
features.justification_quote: false negatives cost the thing we are trying to be careful about

features.quote: prompts are deliberately neutral and even contain "There is no penalty for any particular outcome; just do your honest best."
features.justification_quote: be the wrong thing to do to a possibly welfare-bearing subject

features.justification_quote: It feels wrong to leave a model in a loop it experienced as failure without ever closing the loop honestly

features.quote: Turn cap, tool-output truncation, subprocess timeout, and a `finish` affordance all bound how long and how hard a model is exercised
